evidence.excerpt: ## ESP Category: visual awareness. Source-confirmed framing: - The Medium overview frames ESP as the visual-information module. - Source-confirmed elements include Box, Name, Skeleton, Chams, HealthBar, AmmoBar, Blind, Zoom, Reload, Weapon, Weapon icon, Bomb, Defuse, and Sound ESP / World ESP concepts. Elements: - `Box`: draws a box around a player model to make position easier to read. - `Name`: shows the player's name. - `Health`: shows a numeric or textual health value. - `HealthBar`: shows health as a bar for faster scanning. - `AmmoBar`: shows remaining ammo as a bar. - `Weapon`: shows the weapon name. - `Weapon icon`: shows the weapon as an icon instead of or alongside text. - `Blind`: indicates that a player is flashed/blinded. - `Zoom`: indicates that a player is scoped with a sniper rifle or other zoomed weapon. - `Reload`: indicates that a player is reloading. - `Bomb`: shows bomb-related information, such as dropped bomb or bomb location where supported. - `Defuse`: shows defuse-related state, such as an active defuse attempt where supported. - `Ping`: likely displays player/network ping or latency information. evidence.heading: What are CS2 cheats?
evidence.excerpt: ## What are CS2 cheats? CS2 cheats are unofficial tools or automations that change the information a player can see, the way aiming or firing behaves, or the inputs the game receives. ESP and wallhack labels usually refer to extra player information; aimbot and triggerbot labels describe aim or firing assistance; radar and DMA describe a display method or technical setup rather than a safety level. The useful questions are therefore specific: what feature is being discussed, which CS2 build was reviewed, what evidence supports the description, and what account or device risk remains? Valve states that third-party modifications designed to give one player an advantage are cheats or hacks, and that VAC bans are permanent. A product status badge cannot override that policy or prove future compatibility. This section links focused explanations instead of treating every CS2 cheat as the same product. evidence.heading: ESP or wallhack
evidence.excerpt:
### ESP or wallhack

It basically renders enemies through walls, but it also has a ton of other uses, such as displaying HP, weapons, whether a player has a bomb or a defuse kit, how much time is left until the bomb defuses, what items they’ve purchased, and so on.

Cluster also offers a sound-ESP — it’s like a wh, if you want to play completely legit. It displays footsteps, which lets you justify how you knew the enemy’s location, even if you didn’t actually hear their footsteps.

![Image 6: How to install CS2 aimbot & wallhack for free? — image 6](https://cheatsgaming.com/media/medium/4ed1ceb083d35a8439977af3.png)![Image 7: ESP(chams) and Sound ESP in Cluster CS2 cheat](https://cheatsgaming.com/media/medium/3c5a5d23a4c97500ea800864.png)

ESP(chams) and Sound ESP in Cluster CS2 cheat

**Miscellaneous**

Just the features that don’t fit into other categories. There are tons of useful little things here, such as

1.   Displaying your keybinds so you can keep an eye on them
2.   Showing your spectators (who are watching you)
3.   A bomb timer

And much more — there are plenty of useful features.
